openings: The Oracle stirs, and the stars rearrange themselves to speak of you.
Beyond the veil of ordinary days, the Celestial Order has been watching.
A hush falls over the twelve courts as your fragment of fate comes forward.
The archive of starlight opens to a page that has been waiting for this moment.
Somewhere between one breath and the next, the Wheel of Months turns toward you.
The Oracle does not choose its words carelessly, and it has chosen these for you alone.
celestialEvents: beneath a sky where two moons of memory and possibility hang side by side
as the {realmName} court aligns with a star that has not been named in a thousand years
while {alignment} bends unusually close to the ordinary world
in the narrow hour when starlight and dawn have not yet decided who owns the sky
as the Wheel of Months pauses, just briefly, on the spoke marked by your own becoming
while the tides of the Abyss and the winds of the Aether call a rare truce
destinyMessages: you are closer to the turning point than the ordinary hours have let you believe
a door you assumed was closed has never actually been locked
the version of you still waiting to arrive is not far off now
something you built quietly, without an audience, is about to be seen
the pattern you've been repeating is finally ready to break in your favor
what you have mistaken for delay was, in truth, preparation
warnings: but the Oracle cautions against mistaking speed for progress in the days ahead
though a shortcut will present itself, and it is not the path meant for you
yet pride, left unchecked, could cost you more than patience ever would
so guard against the voice that tells you it is safer to stay exactly as you are
but beware giving your trust to whoever asks for it loudest, rather than truest
though there is a temptation coming to abandon this too early — do not
guidances: Let {creature} remind you that {power} was never something you had to earn twice.
Carry {sigil} in mind as a quiet permission slip to keep going.
When in doubt, ask what {guide} would do, and do the braver version of that.
Return to {element} the way you'd return to an old friend — it already knows what you need.
Trust the instinct that feels inconvenient rather than the one that feels comfortable.
Move at the pace of {creature}, not at the pace of the world's expectations of you.
endings: So the Oracle has spoken, and so it shall unfold, in its own time and no sooner.
This is not a prophecy of certainty, but of tendency — the rest is still yours to choose.
Take what resonates, release what does not, and walk on beneath the same old stars.
The reading closes here, though the story it describes is only just beginning.
May this fragment of fate find you exactly when you needed to hear it, and not a moment later.
The Celestial Order returns to its silence, until you call on it again.
